hypothesis: Held-out weak-prior predictability across months can reflect true common OD affinity or shared observation/prior noise; determine whether pair-based calibration risks erasing changing real demand while retaining common artifacts.
drift: Monthly scales0.85/1/1.15. Stable: same base latent OD; moderate: independent mean-one lognormal path perturbation sd0.35; replaced: new independent latent draw of same geometry family each month.
noise: Independent lognormal sd0.6; shared lognormal path error sd0.6 plus independent sd0.2 (mean-one factors); positive lognormal background sd0.7 amplitude0.8 times truth mean, either independent each month or shared path pattern plus independent amplitude0.1.
features: Span+origin/destination ridge1. Source residual from other two priors only; target prior predictions cross-fit over five fixed case-seeded OD folds. No latent truth enters forecasts or strength selection.
calibration: Freeze all alpha0/0.05/0.25/1 before draws; denoised prior=(1-alpha)*target_prior+alpha*crossfit prediction; all use baseline nonnegative lambda0.05 count solver. Geometry005 is an explicit non-pair control.
selection: None. Public-network shapes repeated but new artificial draws. Prediction MSE of supplied prior and known-latent complete OD components reported separately, including all harms and solver failures.
scope: Artificial assumption stress, not hidden OD validation. Official frozen reference unchanged, no actual candidate export or Kaggle upload.
